name: Skill Check with Token Tracking
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  evaluate-skills:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'
          
      - name: Restore Dependencies
        run: dotnet restore
        
      - name: Build Project
        run: dotnet build --no-restore
        
      - name: Run Skill Evaluation
        id: evaluate
        run: |
          dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator --evaluate
          echo "evaluation_completed=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
      - name: Collect Token Usage
        if: env.evaluation_completed == 'true'
        run: |
          # Extract token metrics from Copilot CLI events
          dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator --collect-tokens
          
      - name: Upload Token Metrics Artifact
        if: env.evaluation_completed == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: token-usage.json
          retention-days: 7
          
      - name: Run Tests
        run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

  generate-dashboard-data:
    needs: evaluate-skills
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Download Token Usage Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: ./artifacts
          
      - name: Generate Dashboard Data
        run: |
          # Aggregate token data from workflow artifacts
          pwsh ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1
          
      - name: Upload Dashboard Data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: dashboard-data.json
          retention-days: 30

  deploy-dashboard:
    needs: generate-dashboard-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Download Dashboard Data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: ./dashboard
          
      - name: Deploy Dashboard
        run: |
          # Deploy Grafana-style dashboard with token usage visualization
          echo "Deploying token usage dashboard..."
          # Implementation would depend on specific deployment strategy
          echo "Dashboard deployed successfully"
